title: Tripura Sundari Temple
geometryBasis: Three aligned roof candidates within the named temple grounds, a documented 24-foot square plan and 75-foot total height, the original doorway photo and independently sampled terrain.
sectionBasis: A 7.3152 metre square brick sanctuary with a 22.86 metre crown, four projecting pillars, six horizontal courses, curved chala roof, and a lower west assembly hall.
limitations: The shrine represents the pre-redevelopment temple. The sanctuary and connected west hall are included. Interior worship spaces, surrounding halls, new visitor facilities and the reservoir are outside scope.

The cleared doorway photograph establishes the red plaster and gold-toned arch. The written dimensions and architectural descriptions constrain the shrine shape. Exact roof profiles, pigments above the door and assembly hall details remain estimated.

Three aligned mapped roof outlines constrain the temple and west assembly hall. These are unnamed roof detections and support approximate exterior registration. The terrain is an original regional DEM and local grade is approximate.
